description.en: Read-only insurance data governance desk: the policy file drive plus QA pairs, featured information, insurer notices and user feedback, with metadata completeness checks and backup and restore from local PDFs.
description.zh-CN: 只读的保险数据治理工作台：保险文件网盘，加上问答对、精选资讯、保司通知与用户反馈，配合元数据完整度检查，以及从本地 PDF 备份与还原。

agentPrompts: Summarize the latest featured information and flag what needs my attention.
Which insurance files are missing metadata or PDF text, and which QA pairs lack a source?
